resumen: Three days a week alternating A and B with a pair of dumbbells and nothing else: squats, lunges, rows, presses and hinges. The chest is worked with push-ups, which need no bench.
matices: Three days alternating A and B work legs, pushing and pulling in every session, and most muscles twice a week, which reviews link with slightly more gain than once. With dumbbells the limit is usually the weight available, but muscle gain happens across a wide range of loads if sets are taken close to failure: when reps go past the range, you can lower more slowly, pause at the bottom or move to the single-leg variation before needing heavier dumbbells.
